name: TAPD
description: Manage stories, bugs, tasks, and iterations. Track progress, break down requirements, update statuses, and log timesheets across the full R&D lifecycle.
authorization.title: Authorize a TAPD account
authorization.description: After an administrator configures an OAuth client, each user signs in and authorizes access on TAPD's official page. Accessible projects and data depend on that user's authorization scope and project permissions.
configuration.endpoint.label: MCP endpoint
configuration.endpoint.description: The official TAPD remote MCP endpoint from the source connector. Keep the default value.
configuration.clientId.label: OAuth Client ID
configuration.clientId.description: The TAPD MCP client ID registered for this Poco deployment. Register the Poco callback URL as described in skills/tapd/references/setup.md in the package.
configuration.clientSecret.label: OAuth Client Secret
configuration.clientSecret.description: The matching client secret, stored encrypted by Poco. The client must use client_secret_post authentication.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.workitems.title: Stories, bugs, and tasks
capabilities.workitems.description: Find pending work, create and update work items, assign owners, change statuses, and read custom fields and workflow settings.
capabilities.planning.title: Projects and iterations
capabilities.planning.description: Find participating projects and project details, create and update iterations, and query release plans and project progress.
capabilities.collaboration.title: Comments, relations, and timesheets
capabilities.collaboration.description: Read and update comments, link stories and bugs, log and query timesheets, and retrieve source commit keywords.
capabilities.knowledge.title: Wiki, test cases, and attachments
capabilities.knowledge.description: Query, create, and update Wiki pages and test cases, create test cases in batches, and retrieve image and attachment download links.
limits.title: Usage limits
limits.description: Available tools must be returned by the remote service and allowed by this connector. Creation, updates, status changes, comments, and timesheet writes require confirmation. After a timeout or an uncertain result, check the actual state before submitting again; writes are never retried automatically.
